root_cause_analysis: Arm D domains contained abundant candidate paths (mean > 15 available), saturating the 15-retrieval cap (98/100 hit cap). Arm U domains were path-sparse (mean 8.41 available paths), exhausting candidate pools before reaching the 15-retrieval cap (50/100 below cap).

budget_definitions.allowed_budget: 15 retrievals/domain cap across both arms (fair protocol ceiling)
budget_definitions.attempted_budget: Actual requests executed (841 in U vs 1470 in D)
budget_definitions.successful_budget: Valid HTTP payloads received and analyzed
budget_definitions.effective_budget: Evaluated candidate paths scoring above baseline
